review.title: Nine preserved community records: scoped species-reference GTDB diagnostic
review.independence_basis: The ten-record source plan received an independent read-only review. Parent independently inspected all nine frozen candidates, exact receipt pins and the complete bounded diff after the separately saved 000388 canary and its verified full input checkpoint. This assessment binds the actual subsequent M5 applications and native gates; it does not infer scientific approval from their success.
review.summary: Twelve explicitly selected taxonomy descriptors across nine whole records now carry native GTDB reference-population correspondences. Original NCBI species/subspecies identities, named study stocks, other classifications, unresolved partners, biological claims and prior history remain unchanged. Each actual guarded application, appended native events, separate native history sidecar and eight scoped commands is bound. Reference populations do not identify uninspected stock assemblies.
review.scope_description: Only the twelve selected taxonomy GTDB blocks/statuses and their actual source/application/check provenance in nine named whole records. Full scientific review, source-snippet matching and corpus QC are outside this diagnostic.
review.selection: The nine remaining units of the independently reviewed ten-record same-name species group, in order 000517, 000431, 000522, 000396, 000397, 000053, 000313, 000426 and 000362. The earlier 000388 canary was saved and its entire input namespace verified before these units were applied serially through the same accepted engine and checker.
limitations: Partial scoped technical and provenance assessment with scientific_review:false; no complete scientific record approval, corpus completion or issue closure is asserted.

Native species-ID populations describe reference genomes keyed to the unchanged NCBI descriptors. They do not demonstrate experimental-stock membership, exact assembly identity, formal nomenclatural change or pathway genotype. Rounded majority fractions are retained without inventing integer numerators.
The L. delbrueckii subsp. lactis NCBI rank and named cheese isolates remain intact although the GTDB correspondence is at species level. The existing S. thermophilus blocks are preserved.
Preprint excerpts for 000396 and abstract coverage for 000397, 000426 and 000362 are explicit source limits. This task does not fill their cultivation, experimental or mechanistic gaps.

Record 000426 retains the unrelated G1B native null result/UNRESOLVED status. Record 000313 retains the cultured-isolate versus network-ASV distinction and the Chlorella no-equivalent state. No missing mapping is turned into a species choice.

The local NCBI read-only adapter supplies inspected label/rank/synonym rows. Its file-stat observations are not a database content hash or release certification. The exact crosswalk, native resolver, source caches and authored context are separately hash-bound.

All original scientific assertions, historical source interpretations and remediation ledgers remain immutable. Historical successor admission, generated products, reference matching and final combined QC require separate integration outcomes.
